title: Subarrays With Sum K
statement:
A subarray is a block of consecutive elements. Count how many non-empty subarrays have a sum exactly equal to `k`. Values can be negative. Subarrays at different positions count separately even when they hold the same numbers.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `k`. The second line contains `n` integers.

## Output
Print the number of subarrays whose sum equals `k`. The answer can be larger than 32 bits.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 100000`
- `-10^9 <= a_i <= 10^9`
- `-10^14 <= k <= 10^14`
